description: Blender — free and open source 3D creation suite. Modelling, sculpting, rigging, animation, simulation, rendering, compositing, motion tracking and video editing.
notes:
Projects are persisted in the /{username}/blender volume, bound to ~/Documents inside the session.

CPU rendering (Cycles/EEVEE) works out of the box. GPU rendering (Cycles CUDA/OptiX) requires the NVIDIA Container Toolkit on the Kasm agent plus a GPU-enabled Workspace (gpu_count >= 1) — set NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all in the Workspace environment once GPU is available.
